description: For a trade and town where get_coverage says bookable, return the visit windows a homeowner can choose from, as start and end times in America/New_York with a readable label. A request takes three windows. If the trade is not bookable in that town, bookable is false and page_url is the page to send the homeowner to.

from_date.description: Optional first day to list, YYYY-MM-DD (America/New_York). Earlier days are left out.

trade.description: The trade, by name or slug.
